args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

src/money.py documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py
to fail in the nightly build. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 ->
2.68 wait, 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring documenting ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: switch the `rounding` argument from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

## Testing

- CI run on branch `fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

This fix is targeted for today's release, so a prompt review from a code owner would be appreciated.
